name: Herodias
summary: The wife of Philip who was married to his brother Herod the tetrarch. When John the Baptist told Herod the marriage was not lawful, she wanted John dead, and she had her daughter ask for his head.

key_moments.title: Wants John the Baptist Dead
key_moments.description: John told Herod it was not lawful for him to have his brother Philip's wife, and Herod put John in prison for her sake. Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him, but she could not, because Herod feared John.

key_moments.title: Tells Her Daughter to Ask for John's Head
key_moments.description: At Herod's birthday supper her daughter danced and pleased him, and he swore to give her whatever she asked. The girl asked her mother what to ask for, and Herodias said, The head of John the Baptist.

key_moments.title: Receives John the Baptist's Head
key_moments.description: Bound by his oath, Herod sent an executioner who beheaded John in the prison. His head was brought on a platter to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.
